body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on shared-gpu-pool-3 — streaming stalls and tail latency increasing. Metric: https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/streaming/pool=shared-gpu-pool-3
oncall-li: Acknowledged. Paging SRE. @maria @aj can you triage? :eyes:
maria: joining — pulling metrics now. do we have affected tenant list?
support-liz: seeing multiple tickets: #12345 (enterprise-corp), #12346 (playground), #12347 (startuplabs). customers report partial completions + stalled streams.
aj: note: p95 crossed 2.5s, p99 ~12s for token generation. streaming stalls at ~1-3s into stream. looks like KV cache stalls? grabbing traces.
maria: trace samples show long wait on disk I/O from worker-7 on host gpu03. blkio wait spikes. suspect noisy tenant writes to /var/tmp/model-cache.
kyle: noisy neighbor pattern. which cgroup profile is enforced on that tenant?
maria: tenant-4821 is running in multi-tenant runtime with blkio weight=500. host nvme utilization hitting 95%.
sre-bot: CPU steal low, but IO waits high. iostat snippet:
```
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s   r/s   w/s  rMB/s  wMB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         0.00    0.01  10.2  92.3  12.4   85.2   10.1     8.9    6.1    1.1    8.9    0.65 95.3
```
support-liz: impact: 3 customers in prod with errors >50% for streaming, 7 test orgs affected. raising severity to Pager.
oncall-li: immediate mitigation suggestions? can we throttle tenant-4821 IO or evict?
maria: two quick mitigations:
- throttle blkio for tenant-4821 (reduce weight)
- migrate active workers for impacted routes to reserve-gpu-pool-1
I can do throttle; migration requires orchestrator ops.
aj: do throttle first. run:
```
echo 200 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/docker/<tenant-4821-cgroup>/blkio.weight
```
then monitor p99.
kyle: if throttle causes long tail retries, fallback plan is to mark tenant for ephemeral eviction and move to isolated pool.
ops-jordan: I can trigger migration to reserve-gpu-pool-1. prepping nodes now.
maria: applying throttle to tenant-4821 -> reducing blkio weight to 200 :hammer_and_wrench:
maria: quick check: within 30s p99 dropped from 12s -> 3.1s; streaming stall rate decreased by ~70% per trace sample. still elevated compared to baseline.
support-liz: customer-facing note: informing impacted customers that we're mitigating noisy-tenant IO and routing traffic to fallback capacity. draft message ready for review.
aj: next step: evac noisy tenant from shared pool to isolated pool and throttle persistent writes into model-cache. ask infra to enforce tmpfs for model-cache on multi-tenant to avoid NVMe pressure.
ops-jordan: started migration job for tenant-4821 to reserve-gpu-pool-1. ETA ~4m.
incident-bot: Migration job created: migration-330555A (tenant-4821 -> reserve-gpu-pool-1). Progress: 0/8 containers moved.
maria: monitoring logs while migration proceeds. also enabling streaming fallback route that serves from smaller model variant for noisy tenant sessions.
aj: note for runbook: adjust cgroup blkio burst settings, add per-tenant IO quotas, and reject heavy filesystem writes from sandbox paths.
kyle: adding short-term QoS rule: route requests for legacy /cache/write endpoints through rate-limiter middleware for 12h.
sre-bot: migration progress: 5/8 containers moved -> worker-3 still draining, logs show `EIO` on write attempts; likely waiting for previous IO flush.
maria: forced-unmount of /var/tmp/model-cache for drained containers, then remount as tmpfs on new host. command used:
```
ssh gpu03 'systemctl stop model-cache && umount /var/tmp/model-cache && mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /var/tmp/model-cache'
```
ops-jordan: migration complete: 8/8 containers moved. confirm p99 baseline for shared-gpu-pool-3 is recovering.
maria: metrics now: p95 ~0.45s, p99 ~0.9s for shared-gpu-pool-3. streaming stalls back to baseline. :partyparrot:
support-liz: updated customers: enterprise-corp acknowledged workaround, playground customers moved to fallback. closing immediate support tickets.
oncall-li: assigning follow-up ownership: @aj lead postmortem (collect traces, timeline, remediation), @maria implement IO quota + tmpfs default, @kyle update routing QoS rule, @ops-jordan verify migrations + add automation for fast-evac.
aj: ack — will schedule postmortem and link to this thread. initial impact summary: severity P1, ~3 prod customers affected, mitigation: blkio throttle + migration + tmpfs remount. probable root cause: unrestricted tenant write-heavy workload saturating NVMe leading to tail latency on streaming paths.
maria: adding observability alert: trigger when nvme_util > 85% AND p99 > 2s for 3m. also adding alert for blkio weight > 450 on a single cgroup.
oncall-li: thanks team. I'll close pager when postmortem attached. turning off on-call escalation for this incident. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved and marked mitigated at 3305551899. Postmortem task created: PM-330555-IO-NN.
